incident-bot: PagerDuty page triggered: policy=latency_p99_eu-west, threshold=1500ms (3m)
incident-bot: PD=INC12345 | Severity=P1 | link=https://redwood.internal/alerts/INC12345
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert routed to #eng-oncall (on-call: Maya Chen)
Maya Chen: ack INC12345, I'm on it. pinging @Simon @Rick
Rick Alvarez: oncall here, confirming p99 spike in eu-west for model-gamma-13B
Jun Li: seeing KV cache eviction spikes and sidecar reconnects in the eu-west cluster
Maya Chen: CPU/GPU on pods looks high, GPU mem at ~99% on several nodes
Maya Chen: running quick checks: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=p99_latency{region="eu-west"}` -> 2.1s
Simon Park: copying runbook excerpt: 1) Confirm scope 2) Check autoscaler 3) Reduce batch sizes / disable prefix batching 4) Rollback recent model/quant rollout 5) Restart sidecars to clear KV cache
Rick Alvarez: recent rollout note: gamma-quant-8b pushed to eu-west ~20h ago
Jun Li: eviction logs (tail): `2026-03-14T09:12:43Z eviction: kv_items=128k, rate=180/min, reason=memory_pressure`
Maya Chen: starting with non-disruptive mitigations: bump autoscaler min replicas and reduce batcher max_tokens
Maya Chen: `kubectl patch hpa inference-gamma -n inference -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 6}}'`
Rick Alvarez: toggling batcher: `redwood config set inference.batch.max_tokens=1024 --env eu-west`
Rick Alvarez: initiating rolling restart of sidecar proxies to clear KV state: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/sidecar-eu -n inference`
Maya Chen: opened ad-hoc bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC12345
Simon Park: I'm taking command. will open an incident channel and escalate to SRE lead if p99 stays >1.5s after 5m
Simon Park: creating temporary traffic fallback: mark gamma-13B in eu-west as deprioritized
Simon Park: `redwood route update --model gamma-13b --region eu-west --weight 10` (reduces traffic)
pagerduty-bot: Escalation to SRE Lead (Simon Park) logged
Jun Li: observing p99 dropping to ~1.6s after sidecar restart
Maya Chen: good sign. throughput recovering but still not within SLO (target p99 < 1.0s)
Rick Alvarez: checking redis/KV cluster: master CPU spikes aligned with eviction events
Maya Chen: customer impact: a subset of EU tenants experience slow responses; no errors returned, only latency degradation. support tickets +12% since spike
Alaa Rahman: hi, taking notes for handoff in 30m. any customer-facing comms drafted?
Maya Chen: draft status: "Degraded performance for inference in eu-west. Engineers mitigating; no data loss."
Simon Park: mitigation plan summary: 1) keep increased min replicas 2) keep batch cap lowered 3) revert quantized kernel in controlled canary in eu-west 4) add alert on kv_eviction_rate > 100/min
Simon Park: initiating controlled rollback for quant job on 2 canaries
Jun Li: rollback started on canary-2 at 3345678985
Maya Chen: monitoring metrics... p99 at 1.2s and trending down
Rick Alvarez: rolling back quant on remainder scheduled after canary validation passes
Maya Chen: confirmed PD ack and bridge notes saved in the incident doc
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 acknowledged by Maya Chen at 3345678920
Simon Park: please note follow-ups: increase KV cache size threshold, add canary gating to rollout pipeline, add autoscaler spike smoothing
Maya Chen: will hand off to @Alaa in 30m for follow-up tracking
Alaa Rahman: I will own the post-incident actions: runbook updates + follow up with platform + customer comms
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 resolved by Maya Chen at 3345679048
Maya Chen: marking incident as resolved. leaving notes: suspected root cause = quantized kernel change increased memory pressure -> KV eviction thrash -> p99 spike. Mitigations that worked: sidecar restart, reduced batching, increase min replicas, canary rollback.
Rick Alvarez: created follow-up ticket PLAT-789: "Investigate gamma-quant memory regressions and improve canary gating"
Simon Park: thanks everyone, good coordination. :thumbsup:
Alaa Rahman: copying timeline into postmortem and scheduling 1:1 with platform in morning
Maya Chen: signing off from bridge. keep watchers in thread for postmortem updates.
